notes: *cometh* is `added` because the gapped colon's Hebrew writes no verb and the supplied word introduces a predication of its own (rules 34 and 20); the ASV's italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).

The materially different reading, named here under rule 8, is that *cometh* is rule 20's construction-supplied linking verb — that rule names *come* among the verbs English writes where a copula would stand — in which case it would join תַּחַת's unit as *cometh in the stead of*, headed on *stead*. It was set aside because the word adds a dynamic entering-into that the Hebrew's bare nominal clause does not write, unlike the bleached *come alike* of rule 20's example.
*in the stead of* is one multi-word rendering of תַּחַת, headed on the content word the phrase turns on (rules 30 and 24).
